priorityModel.P0: must fix before publishing — blocks the gate

rules.why: Guaranteed LLM ranking/citation claims are false and erode trust.
rules.fix: Report sampled visibility and cite method, never a guarantee.

rules.why: A canonical with no built route yields a 404/soft-404 that sitemap publishes.
rules.fix: Create the Astro route or fix the canonical to an existing route.

rules.why: Site language is enforced to English.
rules.fix: Translate remaining CJK characters to English.

rules.why: A markdown link to a non-existent route is a hard 404.
rules.fix: Point the link at an existing route or remove it.

rules.why: A wikilink with no vault target renders as plain text (no link equity, no navigation).
rules.fix: Point the wikilink at an existing vault node, or use the correct node name.

rules.why: Descriptions beyond ~160 characters are truncated and lose the answer.
rules.fix: Compress to 150-160: keyword + core answer, drop modifiers.

rules.why: An evidence id that is not in evidence_index.json is an unverifiable citation.
rules.fix: Use an existing ev-XXX id or add the source to the evidence index.

rules.why: Enum fields drive routing, schema, and template selection.
rules.fix: Use one of the allowed enum values from lint.config.json.

rules.why: Frontmatter is the machine contract every page is validated against.
rules.fix: Add the missing frontmatter field(s) listed in the report.

rules.why: Two pages sharing a canonical split ranking signals and can deindex one.
rules.fix: Give each page a distinct canonical URL that matches its route.

rules.why: A single H1 names the page topic for crawlers and assistive tech.
rules.fix: Keep exactly one body H1 (the title is rendered from frontmatter).

rules.why: Hard-block AI filler phrases; they read as machine-written.
rules.fix: Rewrite the sentence without the phrase.

rules.why: A page citing ev-* inline must list those ids in frontmatter evidence.
rules.fix: Backfill frontmatter evidence with the inline-cited ids.

rules.why: Duplicate meta descriptions reduce click distinctiveness.
rules.fix: Rewrite one description around its page-specific promise.

rules.why: One keyword per page prevents cannibalization.
rules.fix: Merge the pages or re-target one keyword.

rules.why: Duplicate titles compete in the SERP and weaken distinctiveness.
rules.fix: Rewrite one title to name its unique angle.

rules.why: Cross-page links give crawlers paths and pass topical relevance.
rules.fix: Add at least three links to related XKnow pages.

rules.why: Corporate jargon weakens specific, human writing.
rules.fix: Use the replacement suggested in the report.

rules.why: Titles beyond ~60 characters truncate in the SERP and lose CTR.
rules.fix: Move the primary keyword to the front and cut the tail.

rules.why: Vault notes feed the knowledge graph and the MCP index.
rules.fix: Restore frontmatter/type/brand on the vault note.

rules.why: 8-14 wikilinks weave the page into the knowledge graph without stuffing.
rules.fix: Add natural inline wikilinks to real vault nodes, or trim the excess.

rules.why: Pages under the guide floor read as thin and rarely satisfy intent.
rules.fix: Expand only where a real sub-question is unanswered.

rules.why: Every page should end with a next step (hub or vault CTA).
rules.fix: Add a closing CTA section linking a related page or the vault.

rules.why: The opening should confirm the query is answered here.
rules.fix: Mention the primary topic or a close variant in the first paragraph if natural.

rules.why: Subheadings create scannable structure and snippet targets.
rules.fix: Add H2 sections every ~300 words.

rules.why: Over ~3% exact-match repetition reads as stuffing.
rules.fix: Replace forced repetitions with variants and pronouns.

rules.why: Weak qualifiers add length without meaning.
rules.fix: Cut or replace with specific language.

rules.why: Very short vault notes carry little reusable knowledge.
rules.fix: Expand the note or merge it into a richer one.

rules.why: The body H1 and frontmatter title should not silently diverge.
rules.fix: Make the body H1 match the frontmatter title.
